summary: The root قوع (qwE) refers to a level, plain, or soft piece of land. It is often described as low-lying, free from mountains, and sometimes as land that produces nothing.
lane: قَاعٌ ذ An even place; (S, voce مَقَدٌّ ;) plain, or level, land, (S, Msb,) that produces nothing; (IF, Msb;) plain, or soft, land, ( أَرْضٌ سَهْلَةٌ ,) low, and free from mountains. (K.) See also رَوْضَةٌ . Respecting its pls., see جَارٌ .
